summary: Federal Communications Commission urges preservation of E-Rate program to ensure broadband infrastructure for schools and libraries. Support for the connectivity and internal network infrastructure schools need to provide reliable educational access; and

claims.argument: Reducing E-Rate would require cutting programs and resources, competing with other budget priorities
claims.evidence_quote: Absorbing the loss of E-Rate funding will require us to cut programs and eliminate other necessary resources, as our network is vital for daily operations.
